is_anopheles.evidence: The study was conducted on wild Anopheles gambiae s.s. collected in experimental huts and as larvae in Côte d'Ivoire (e.g. Page 1, Abstract; Page 2, Methods).

reports_target_markers.evidence: TaqMan PCR was used for 'Molecular detection of the kdr (L1014F) and ace-1R (G119S) mutation alleles in live and dead samples from the hut treatments' (Page 4, Selection of insecticide resistance genes).

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: Table 4 lists allele frequencies and sample sizes (n) for kdr and ace-1R across treatments for live and dead mosquitoes; Table 5 presents detailed genotype counts (SS, RS, RR live/total) for both markers across all experimental hut treatments.

african_field_population.evidence: Experimental hut trials and larval collections were conducted in Tiassalé (5°54' N, 4°50' W), southern Côte d’Ivoire (Page 2, Study site).

is_primary_study.evidence: This is an original experimental hut research trial reporting primary phenotypic and genotypic resistance data.

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: The paper describes two six-week experimental hut trials, but does not state the calendar year(s) or dates during which the collections took place.

duplicate_risk.evidence: The mosquito collections were primary experimental hut collections specific to this study conducted under the AvecNet project.

supplement.evidence: All relevant bioassay results, genotype counts, and allele frequencies are provided in Tables 1-5 of the main text.

assessment.summary: This study evaluated the efficacy of pirimiphos-methyl-treated plastic wall linings and net hangings alone and in combination with LLINs in experimental huts in Tiassalé, Côte d'Ivoire. Genotyping of Vgsc L1014F (L995F) and Ace-1 G119S (G280S) was performed on Anopheles gambiae s.s. collected from huts, with complete genotype and allele data reported for survivors and non-survivors across treatments.
